description: Defines data structures, enums, and function prototypes for handling list-objects filter options, including filter choices, parsing, and configuration.

methods.name: list_objects_filter_init
methods.description: Initializes a list_objects_filter_options structure with default values.

methods.name: gently_parse_list_objects_filter
methods.description: Parses the filter argument from command line or protocol request into filter options.

methods.name: list_objects_filter_die_if_populated
methods.description: Terminates if the filter options are already populated.

methods.name: parse_list_objects_filter
methods.description: Parses and combines filter specifications, with error handling.

methods.name: opt_parse_list_objects_filter
methods.description: Callback for parsing filter options from command-line options.

methods.name: expand_list_objects_filter_spec
methods.description: Expands abbreviated numbers in filter specifications to full form.

methods.name: list_objects_filter_spec
methods.description: Returns the user-entered filter specification string.

methods.name: list_objects_filter_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with filter options.

methods.name: list_objects_filter_set_no_filter
methods.description: Sets the filter options to disable filtering.

methods.name: partial_clone_register
methods.description: Registers a partial clone with specific filter options.

methods.name: partial_clone_get_default_filter_spec
methods.description: Retrieves default filter spec for a remote during partial clone.

methods.name: list_objects_filter_copy
methods.description: Copies filter options from source to destination.
